card.name: Pointers to what comes next: below, following
card.fires_on: The words "below", "following" or "follows" that point ahead to a list or steps. They come after phrases like "follow directions", "the instructions", or "one or more of the".

modes.label: Directions below
modes.description: "below" after follow directions or instructions, pointing to steps further down.
modes.example: If supplemental medication is desired, follow directions<< below>> before preparing for administration.

modes.label: Following conditions
modes.description: "following" after "one or more of the" introducing a list of conditions.
modes.example: LILETTA is contraindicated when one or more of the<< following>> conditions exist: Pregnancy [see Use in

modes.label: As follows
modes.example: the suggested procedure is as<< follows>>: After the first one to two weeks
